items.claim: He averages more than five takedowns per 15 minutes through relentless volume rather than dominant control.
items.quote: getting more than five takedowns per 15 minutes because it's just takedown, takedown, takedown, takedown. But he does set a relentless pace.

items.claim: He has poor durability and has been dropped in six of his 13 UFC fights.
items.quote: He is unfortunately pretty chinny. He has been dropped in six of his 13 UFC fights.

items.claim: He is a good striker who utilizes kicks for range management and works the body.
items.quote: Quilan Sal Kid, a good striker who uses kicks really well to manage his range. He works the body.

items.claim: He is a well-rounded fighter who will wrestle when comfortable on the feet and possesses a BJJ black belt.
items.quote: He's very well-rounded. He's very aggressive and he can find finishes. He is a BJJ black belt
